changelog:
Initial release of doc-reader: a local tool for extracting clean, structured text from PDF/DOCX/TXT files.

- Supports PDF (pypdf), DOCX (python-docx), and TXT/MD formats
- Extracts pure text while preserving structure (titles, paragraphs, tables)
- CLI script for full text, structured JSON output, page/paragraph limits
- Designed for contract/resume/report parsing, knowledge ingestion, and preprocessing for downstream summarization or extraction
- Includes notes on workflow integration, format/encoding pitfalls, and security boundaries
summary: 本地文档读取技能。从 PDF / DOCX / TXT 抽取纯文本与结构（标题/段落/表格），供摘要、检索、结构化抽取下游使用。内置 doc_extract 脚本（优先本地库，无依赖时回退提示）。适用于合同/简历/报告解析、知识入库、长文预处理。
